method.node: individual nucleus centroid from canonical common objects
method.feature: binary indicator: 1 for Epithelial, 0 for every other nucleus class

weights.matrix_order: Explicit input nucleus order; aligned with feature values and output IDs
weights.node_definition: one node per retained nucleus centroid
weights.formula: w_ij = exp(-sigma * r_ij) for 0 < r_ij <= distance_threshold; otherwise 0
weights.row_standardization: Applied by the Global or Local Moran caller after matrix construction.

method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across finite computed p-values only; isolated nuclei excluded.
method.island_policy: Retain all nuclei; no-neighbour local statistics and significance are null, not zero or not significant.
method.reference_population: All retained nuclei, including isolates, define feature mean/variance and the conditional permutation pool.

interpretation_warning: Exploratory spatial analysis of supplied class labels; not validation of those labels or clinical significance.
